decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.7086. Series context: trend strength 0.9563 and seasonal strength 0.0535; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.267); 9 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 7.339.
